items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this reader. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(elementType, null). The list may also exclude media types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此读取器支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canWrite(elementType, null) 进行保护。该列表也可能排除仅针对特定元素类型支持的媒体类型。或者，使用 HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。

items.source: Determine the Content-Type of the HTTP message based on the "Content-Type" header or otherwise default to MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM.
items.translation: 根据 "Content-Type" 标头确定 HTTP 消息的 Content-Type，否则默认为 MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this Reader for the given type of element. This list may differ from HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes() if the Reader doesn't support the element type, or if it supports it only for a subset of media types.
items.translation: 返回此 Reader 针对给定元素类型支持的媒体类型列表。如果 Reader 不支持该元素类型，或仅支持其子集的媒体类型，则该列表可能与 HttpMessageReader.getReadableMediaTypes() 不同。

items.source: Get additional hints for decoding for example based on the server request or annotations from controller method parameters. By default, delegate to the decoder if it is an instance of HttpMessageDecoder.
